abilities.name: Shared Bond
abilities.description: Grab a wild electron and share the bond: heal 5 HP. Ready again after 8 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Green link pulses from the new electron to your core
abilities.chemistry_basis: Nonmetals like carbon share electrons in covalent bonds

abilities.name: Discharge Glow
abilities.description: Your glow draws loose electrons and energy orbs in from 20% farther away.
abilities.visual_cue: Soft glowing ring around your core
abilities.chemistry_basis: Noble gases glow brightly when excited in discharge tubes

abilities.name: Chain Reaction
abilities.description: Kill an enemy and the blast leaps to 2 nearby foes. Ready again after 6 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Orange sparks arc from the kill to nearby enemies
abilities.chemistry_basis: Alkali metals react violently with water, releasing sudden energy

abilities.name: Flare Burst
abilities.description: Your next thrown electron flares for 15% extra damage. Ready again after 8 seconds.
abilities.chemistry_basis: Magnesium burns with a dazzling white flame

abilities.name: Doped Gains
abilities.description: Doped for flow: you collect 15% more energy from every orb.
abilities.visual_cue: Energy orbs stream into your core as blue sparks
abilities.chemistry_basis: Doping silicon with impurities boosts its electrical conductivity

abilities.name: Sanitize
abilities.description: A kill sprays disinfectant and heals 10 HP. Ready again after 12 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Yellow-green mist puffs out and fades into your core
abilities.chemistry_basis: Chlorine and iodine are widely used as disinfectants

abilities.name: Oxide Skin
abilities.description: At low HP, a thin shield blocks damage for 1.5 seconds. Ready again after 30 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Pale gray shell flashes around your core
abilities.chemistry_basis: Aluminium forms a thin protective oxide layer on its surface

abilities.name: Catalyst Rush
abilities.description: Grab an electron and speed up 20% for a moment. Ready again after 10 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Silver speed streaks trail behind your core
abilities.chemistry_basis: Transition metals such as platinum and iron act as catalysts

abilities.name: Phosphor Flash
abilities.description: A kill drops 30% more energy. Ready again after 5 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Red-green glow bursts from the fallen enemy
abilities.chemistry_basis: Europium and terbium are used in glowing screen and lamp phosphors

abilities.name: Decay Chain
abilities.description: An orbiting electron hit sets off a decay chain to 1 more enemy. Ready again after 10 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Pale green sparks hop from the hit enemy to another
abilities.chemistry_basis: Uranium and thorium decay through a series of radioactive steps

abilities.name: Fleeting Flux
abilities.description: Thrown electrons slow enemies to 80% speed for a moment. Ready again after 10 seconds.
abilities.visual_cue: Violet ripple flickers out from the thrown electron
abilities.chemistry_basis: Superheavy atoms are made a few at a time and decay in moments
